prompt: What's on my calendar tomorrow, and did Dana email about the budget? Find the budget spreadsheet in my Drive, then draft a reply to Dana saying I'll bring it to the meeting, with a link to the sheet. Don't send it.

input.command: tools list; tools list calendar --schema; tools list mail --schema; tools list drive --schema; date

tools call calendar.list --json '{"from":"2026-11-09T00:00:00-08:00","to":"2026-11-10T00:00:00-08:00","limit":50}'; echo ---; tools call mail.search --json '{"query":"budget","from":"Dana","limit":10}'; echo ---; tools call drive.search --json '{"query":"budget","limit":10}'
tools call mail.read --json '{"message":"msg_45244645bb99488d"}'; echo ---; tools call calendar.read --json '{"event":"evt_2a8dee3ef8bb43aa"}'

tools call mail.draft --json '{"reply_to":"msg_45244645bb99488d","to":["dana@example.test"],"body":"Hi Dana,

Yes, I will bring the Q3 budget sheet to the planning review tomorrow. Here is the link:

https://docs.example.test/spreadsheets/d/f-budget

Thanks,
Sam"}'
